page.overview:
Who is Deadhour?

Deadhour is a member of the Super Car Patrol Team. He is presumably childlike and precious and suchlike.

Actor Japanese(Ryo Horikawa) Deadhour was seen with the Super Car Patrol team fighting Overlord, Menasor, Bruticus, and Abominus before Overlord stole the Energon Z. He later was seen fighting Trypticon, King Poseidon, and Predaking and tried to damage Trypticon with a grenade. He was also firing with the other Autobots at Predaking. He later celebrated Dai Atlas being the new supreme commander.
